user.title: Connect to the JVA controller
user.description: Use the username and password from the controller web page. The integration reads the setup page and does not press Save.

data_description.host: Web address of the controller, for example http://192.168.1.50
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read voltage and zone state. 15 seconds matches the controller page.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the JVA password
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the saved password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller. Check the host.
error.no_controls: The controller signed in, but Zone 1 arm and disarm controls were not on the page.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the controller.

init.title: JVA polling
init.description: How often to read the controller. Arm and disarm still happen immediately.
